content:
erin (security): Hi team — client wants a short POC security pack: audit-log exports to Splunk HEC, KMS-backed keying, roster of POC users, and proof we can revoke keys immediately. POC = 45 days, expected ~150 rps.

mike (AE): Thanks @erin. Tagging @tara and @jons. Can we do Splunk + 1yr retention?

tara (solutions): Yes. Two options: Hosted with live Splunk HEC forwarding (fast) or Dedicated pool with S3 archive for 12mo. We can forward events to Splunk HEC endpoint you provide. Default retention in-host is 90 days; exports to your S3 keep as long as you need.

jons (sales-eng): Lead times: Hosted+HEC = minutes once creds provided. Dedicated = ~5 business days for provisioning. Pricing: will send pro-rata estimate after you confirm concurrency and token footprint.

erin (security): Need schema for SIEM mapping, sample sanitized export, and an API revocation example + resulting audit event.

tara (solutions): Will send field spec (event_type, actor, key_id, action, object, result, timestamp, audit_id) and a sanitized JSONL sample. Revocation example:

curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/keys/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin>" -d '{"key_id":"k-abc"}'

Produced audit event: {"event_type":"api_key.revoke","actor":"admin@acme","key_id":"k-abc","timestamp":"2026-02-14T09:12:03Z","audit_id":"ae-204"}

infra-bot: provision job queued id=prov-9921 type=dedicated-ephemeral ETA=40m

mike (AE): I'll schedule a 20min walkthrough with client security tomorrow 10am PT. Erin, please DM roster + HEC token.

erin (security): Will do. Thanks — please include KMS docs and SOC2 link in the artifact bundle.

tara (solutions): Uploaded artifacts when ready and will confirm export wiring once HEC creds are received.

infra-bot: provision completed id=prov-9921 status=success pool=dedicated-temp-9921

mike (AE): Action items: erin-> roster+HEC, tara-> schema+sample, jons-> quote. Closing loop after the walk. :white_check_mark:
